# mockingbird_llm_profile (Resource)

An LLM profile: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model that mocks generate responses with. The API key is only ever a **reference** (`env:NAME`) resolved by the Mockingbird server, never a value, so no secret reaches the Terraform state. Through the API a reference must match the server's `server.api_secret_refs` (default `env:MB_LLM_*` or `env:*_API_KEY`), and only a sysadmin may set it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key stays on the Mockingbird server: secret_ref names the environment
# variable it reads, so no secret reaches the Terraform state.
resource "mockingbird_llm_profile" "default" {
  name        = "openrouter"
  base_url    = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
  model       = "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
  secret_ref  = "env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
  json_schema = true
  temperature = 0.4
  headers = {
    "x-title" = "Mockingbird staging"
  }
  extra_body = jsonencode({ provider = { sort = "price" } })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com` or `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
- `model` (String) Model name.
- `name` (String) Profile name, 1–128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`.

### Optional

- `extra_body` (String) JSON object merged into every provider request body (at most 8 KiB, not for secrets), e.g. `jsonencode({ provider = { sort = "price" } })`.
- `fallback_profile` (String) Profile tried when this one fails.
- `headers` (Map of String) Extra provider request headers by lowercase name. A value may embed secret references as `${env:NAME}`; a header whose name suggests a credential must use one.
- `json_schema` (Boolean) Use the provider's `json_schema` response format.
- `max_tokens` (Number) Most tokens per completion. Default `16384`.
- `secret_ref` (String) Reference to the API key on the Mockingbird server, e.g. `env:MB_LLM_API_KEY` or `env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. Never the key itself.
- `temperature` (Number) Sampling temperature. Default `0.7`.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Request timeout. Default `60000`.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace of the resource. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, `<workspace>/<name>`; also the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An LLM profile is imported as <workspace>/<name>.
terraform import mockingbird_llm_profile.default default/openrouter
```
